source: English curated paraphrase; structure follows the Chinese pattern library.

紫府同宫.rule: 紫微、天府同宫守命（寅或申）
紫府同宫.note: With both major stars in one palace, life has room and a measure of luck. A touch of loneliness can surface at times; let relationships develop at their own pace.
紫府同宫.nameEn: Ziwei and Tianfu in the Same Palace

府相朝垣.rule: 天府、天相会照命宫三方四正
府相朝垣.note: Steady, with people backing you up. Progress comes easiest by climbing step by step within an established system.

机月同梁.rule: 天机、太阴、天同、天梁齐会命宫三方四正
机月同梁.note: Well suited to public service, education, and mass communication. Moving steadily forward is enough.

巨机同临.rule: 天机、巨门同宫守命（卯或酉）
巨机同临.note: A quick mind and a sharp tongue. Deepening one specialty, especially in technology or a professional field, brings the most reward.

月朗天门.note: Refined and inward, you prefer to accumulate slowly. Cultural work and behind-the-scenes roles feel natural.
月朗天门.nameEn: Moon Bright at the Heavenly Gate

日照雷门.note: Open and outgoing, willing to say what you think. Public service, communications, and education all fit.
日照雷门.nameEn: Sun Shining at the Thunder Gate

石中隐玉.note: You speak well, but can get pulled into idle talk. Standing on one solid expertise is safest; leave a little unsaid.

七杀朝斗.note: Suited to forging your own path and to disciplined, structured work. Taking the initiative helps; tempering the edge keeps it steady.

极向离明.note: A clear and distinguished pattern. You shine brightest with people supporting you, so avoid carrying everything alone.

贪武同行.rule: 武曲、贪狼同宫守命（丑或未）
贪武同行.note: Money and ideas arrive together. Solid, steady enterprise suits you; an oversized leap is unnecessary.

日月并明.rule: 太阳、太阴同宫守命（丑或未）
日月并明.note: You carry both warmth and stillness. Even out your rhythm and sleep, and things settle.

君臣庆会.rule: 紫微守命，三方四正会左辅右弼、文昌文曲、天魁天钺
君臣庆会.note: A favorable pattern with frequent help from others. Accomplishing things through a team comes more easily than deciding alone.

巨日同宫.rule: 太阳、巨门同宫守命（寅或申）
巨日同宫.note: Expressive and open. Communications, education, and law fit well; staying out of petty friction saves energy.
巨日同宫.nameEn: Jumen and Sun in the Same Palace

机梁加会.rule: 天机、天梁同宫或三方会照命宫
机梁加会.note: Able to plan and to stay grounded. Planning, research, and public-interest work suit you.

文梁振纪.note: Both talent and principle. Culture, education, legal affairs, and public service all let you contribute.

阳梁昌禄.rule: 太阳、天梁、文昌、禄存齐会命宫三方四正
阳梁昌禄.note: Examinations and steady income tend to go well. Public service and education are smooth paths.

三奇加会.rule: 化禄、化权、化科三奇会照命宫三方四正
三奇加会.note: All three auspicious transformations arrive together and the pattern is bright. Follow the momentum and stay unpretentious.

左右同宫.note: Many helpers and good rapport. Working with a team takes the least effort.
左右同宫.nameEn: Zuofu and Youbi in the Same Palace

文桂文华.note: Bright and multi-talented. Writing and exams tend to go well, especially when you follow through.

将星得地.note: Strong execution. Finance and real industry both suit you; a softer tone widens the road.
将星得地.nameEn: The General Star in Its Element

月生沧海.note: Refined and inward. Cultural work, finance, and behind-the-scenes planning all feel at home.

寿星入庙.note: A natural protective quality. Profession and public service both fit; don't take on everyone's burdens.

英星入庙.note: Bold in breaking and building, with real momentum. Excellent for pioneering; stay with the finish a little longer.

马头带箭.note: Fiery and full of drive. Disciplined or competitive fields suit you; half a second's pause before acting is safer.

紫府朝垣.note: A major star well placed, with helpful stars alongside. A clear and distinguished pattern.

天府朝垣.note: A major star guarding the treasury. Deep reserves of good fortune; steady keeping brings comfort.

金灿光辉.note: Like the sun at midday, a bright pattern. When ups and downs come, slow the pace.

明珠出海.rule: 命宫在未无主星，卯宫太阳天梁、亥宫太阴合照
明珠出海.note: Three stars form a line, making it easier to be noticed for reputation and achievement.
明珠出海.nameEn: Bright Pearl Emerging from the Sea

天乙拱命.note: Noble helpers surround you; people are often willing to lend a hand.

权禄巡逢.note: Authority and reward arrive together, a bright pattern, especially when the stars are well placed.

科权禄夹.rule: 化科、化权、化禄中有二居命宫两侧
科权禄夹.note: Three auspicious transformations flank you from either side, a refined pattern.

双禄夹命.note: Two forms of reward flank the palace, bringing relative ease with money.
双禄夹命.nameEn: Double Reward Flanking the Life Palace

三合火贪.rule: 火星与贪狼同宫或三合
三合火贪.note: Fire meets Tanlang, often a sudden burst of brightness for a time, most marked when your state is strong.

贪铃朝垣.note: Lingxing with Tanlang gives presence and the ability to rally people, better when things are calm.
贪铃朝垣.nameEn: Tanlang and Rahu in the Same Palace

贵星夹命.rule: 紫微天府夹命，或太阳太阴夹命
贵星夹命.note: Noble stars on either side, a favorable pattern with frequent help from others.
贵星夹命.nameEn: Noble Stars Flanking the Life Palace

廉贞文武.rule: 廉贞在寅或申，文昌文曲三方拱照
廉贞文武.note: At home with both principle and culture. Law, public order, and the arts all let you contribute.
廉贞文武.nameEn: Lianzhen with Literary and Martial Stars

辅拱文星.rule: 文昌守命，左辅三方拱照
辅拱文星.note: Talent backed by helpers. Cultural work and planning come easily.

禄文拱命.rule: 禄存守命，三方得昌曲拱照
禄文拱命.note: Reward and reputation both arrive smoothly. Just don't let outside noise set your rhythm.
禄文拱命.nameEn: Reward and Literature Flanking the Life Palace

禄合鸳鸯.note: Two rewards in the same palace, bringing ample income.
禄合鸳鸯.nameEn: Two Rewards in the Same Palace

双禄朝垣.rule: 三方四正有禄存与化禄
双禄朝垣.note: Two rewards come together; both finances and pattern are good. Slow down when ups and downs appear.

禄马交驰.rule: 三方四正有禄存或化禄，又有天马
禄马交驰.note: Often on the move, and able to earn away from home.

二曜同临.rule: 命在丑日月在未，或命在未日月在丑
二曜同临.note: Sun and moon shine on each other, a clear pattern. Steadiness makes it smoother.
二曜同临.nameEn: The Two Luminaries Facing Each Other

丹桂.rule: 太阳在辰或巳守命，或太阴在酉或戌守命
丹桂.note: Both major stars well placed; recognition tends to come early in life.

甲第登庸.note: Academic and management paths both go more smoothly when these two stars face each other.

科名会禄.note: Reputation and income both tend to grow gradually when these meet.

明禄暗禄.rule: 命宫有化禄或禄存，暗合宫有另一个
明禄暗禄.note: Reward in both the open and hidden palaces; income paths connect more smoothly.
明禄暗禄.nameEn: Reward in Open and Hidden Palaces

权星朝垣.note: Authority in the life palace. Willing to carry responsibility, and more likely to succeed with help.
权星朝垣.nameEn: The Authority Star in the Life Palace

禄马佩印.rule: 禄存或化禄与天马、天相同宫守命
禄马佩印.note: Reward and travel with a seal of office: steady income and a title that carries weight.
禄马佩印.nameEn: Reward, Horse and Seal of Office

财禄夹马.rule: 天马守命，邻宫有武曲与化禄相夹
财禄夹马.note: Wealth and reward flank the traveling star. Tighter early on, easing later.
财禄夹马.nameEn: Wealth and Reward Flanking the Horse

日月照壁.rule: 破军在辰或戌守命，太阳太阴在丑或未（田宅）
日月照壁.note: Family assets tend to accumulate; auspicious stars in the trine make it steadier.
日月照壁.nameEn: Sun and Moon Illuminating the Wall

化星返贵.rule: 天同在戌守命逢丁年，或巨门在辰守命逢辛年
化星返贵.note: An unusual pattern where an adverse transformation in an ordinary palace turns into distinction.

科明禄暗.rule: 化科守命，暗合宫有禄存或化禄
科明禄暗.note: Reputation in the open, reward in the hidden; name and income arrive together.

羊陀夹煞.rule: 煞星坐宫被两邻宫擎羊、陀罗夹制
羊陀夹煞.note: Two harsh stars press in from either side, easily stirring the temper. Give yourself more cushion in this phase.
羊陀夹煞.nameEn: Qingyang and Tuoluo Flanking a Harsh Star

火铃夹煞.rule: 煞星坐宫被两邻宫火星、铃星夹制
火铃夹煞.note: Fire and bell press in; small surprises can appear from nowhere. Leave a margin and you won't be flustered.
火铃夹煞.nameEn: Mars and Rahu Flanking a Harsh Star

空劫夹煞.rule: 煞星坐宫被两邻宫地空、地劫夹制
空劫夹煞.note: Void and robbery press in; ideas and reality tug against each other. Make the task in front of you solid.
空劫夹煞.nameEn: Void and Robbery Flanking a Harsh Star

双忌夹煞.rule: 生年忌与大限忌夹制煞星坐宫
双忌夹煞.note: Two adverse transformations press in; matters easily repeat. Go slowly and give yourself more time.
双忌夹煞.nameEn: Double Affliction Flanking a Harsh Star

三方皆煞.rule: 命宫、财帛、官禄、迁移皆坐煞星
三方皆煞.note: Harsh stars in all four key palaces. More obstacles along the way, but taking them one at a time keeps you steady.
三方皆煞.nameEn: Harsh Stars in All Four Directions

七杀羊陀迭并.rule: 七杀守命，羊陀同宫或会照
七杀羊陀迭并.note: Quick-tempered and prone to head-on conflict. Structured, disciplined fields let you use that force well.

刑囚夹印.rule: 廉贞、天相、擎羊（或陀罗）三合会照
刑囚夹印.note: Rules and disputes easily arise. Legal affairs and public order, where rules are clear, suit you.
刑囚夹印.nameEn: Punishment and Prison Flanking the Seal

路上埋尸.rule: 廉贞、七杀、擎羊（或陀罗）会照
路上埋尸.note: Much coming and going, and a tendency to knock against things. Structured, rhythmic roles are safer.

巨火羊.note: Words and temper both tend to come first. Pause half a beat before speaking.

巨铃羊.note: Easily startled by idle talk. Steady yourself before acting.

铃昌陀武.rule: 铃星、文昌、陀罗、武曲会照
铃昌陀武.note: Things tend to stall and restart. Holding the rhythm beats rushing.

天机天梁擎羊会.note: Ups and downs with a hard edge. Rooting yourself in a technical specialty puts that force to good use.

权杀化禄.rule: 羊陀火铃坐命入庙，三方有化禄化权
权杀化禄.note: Strong presence and boldness. Challenging or disciplined work suits you, especially with helpful stars nearby.
